p: burden of Tyre: Read Geneva "Isa 13:1"
Tarshish: You of Cilicia that come here for merchandise.
it is laid waste: Tyrus is destroyed by Nebuchadnezzar.
Chittim it is: By Chittim they meant all the isles and countries west of Palestine.
revealed to them: All men know of this destruction.
replenished: Have hunted and enriched you.
seed of Sihor: Meaning, the corn of Egypt which was fed by the overflowing of the Nile.
sea hath spoken: That is, Tyrus, which was the chief part of the sea.
travail not: I have no people left in me, and am as a barren woman, that never had children.
greatly pained at the report of: Because these two countries were joined in league together.
Tarshish: Tyrus wills other merchants to go to Cilicia, and to come no more there.
crowning city: Who makes her merchants like princes.
daughter of Tarshish: Your strength will no more serve you: therefore flee to other countries for comfort.
virgin: For Tyre was never touched nor afflicted before.
daughter of Zidon: Because Tyrus was built by them of Zidon.
Assyrian founded it for them that: The Chaldeans who dwelt in tents in the wilderness were gathered by the Assyrians into cities.

brought it to ruin: The people of the Chaldeans destroyed the Assyrians: by which the prophet means that seeing the Chaldaeans were able to overcome the Assyrians who were so great a nation, much more will these two nations of Chaldea and Assyria be able to overthrow Tyrus.
strength is laid waste: That is, Tyrus by whom you are enriched.
seventy years shall Tyre: Tyrus will lie destroyed seventy years which he calls the reign of one king, or a man's age.
sing as an harlot: Will use all craft and subtilty to entice men again to her.
make sweet melody: She will labour by all means to recover her first credit, as a harlot when she is long forgotten, seeks by all means to entertain her lovers.
hire: Though she has been chastised by the Lord, yet she will return to her old wicked practises and for gain will give herself to all men's lusts like a harlot.

holiness to the LORD: He shows that God yet by the preaching of the gospel will call Tyre to repentance and turn her heart from evil and filthy gain, to the true worshipping of God, and liberality toward his saints.
